LightningComponentBundle.description: Add a form to collect payment details using Salesforce Payments at checkout.

property.name: checkoutDetails
property.label: Checkout Binding Expression
property.description: Access checkout data. {!Checkout.Details} is the fixed text for this expression. Do not change or delete.

property.name: cartDetails
property.label: Cart Details Binding Expression
property.description: Access cart details data. {!Checkout.CartDetails} is the fixed text for this expression. Do not change or delete.

property.name: cartTotals
property.label: Cart Totals Binding Expression
property.description: Access cart totals data. {!Checkout.CartTotals} is the fixed text for this expression. Do not change or delete.

property.name: paymentMethodSetId
property.label: Payment Method Set Key
property.description: Shows a configured set of payment methods at checkout. Find the key on the Merchant Account related list page.

property.name: useManualCapture
property.label: Use Manual Capture
property.description: Places a hold on authorized payments before capturing them at a later time. Some payment methods do not support manual capture and continue to process automatically.

property.label: Allow Saved Payment Method
property.name: enableSavedPaymentMethods
property.description: Lets logged-in buyers save their payment information at checkout.

property.name: enableBusinessAch
property.label: Allow Business ACH Accounts
property.description: Lets buyers use business bank accounts for ACH payments.

property.label: SEPA Debit Mandate
property.name: sepaDebitMandate
property.description: Use this field to customize the text of the SEPA mandate. If you leave this field blank, the default text is used.
